summary: Logistic Properties of the Americas (LPA) filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the reporting dates for its Second Quarter 2026 financial results. The earnings release is scheduled for after market close on August 12, 2026, with a conference call on August 13, 2026. No transaction, material corporate event, or special situation is disclosed. This is a routine earnings date announcement, not a special situation filing.
